posts.title: Fall Writing Frenzy 2026 has begun!
posts.description: Hi Friends, I hope you’re having a lovely fall. I’m delighted to share that our 2026 Fall Writing Frenzy has officially begun! Post your entry here by 9 pm EST on Oct 8th: https://lydialukidis.wordpress.com/2026/10/01/fall-writing-frenzy-entry-form-2026/ Check out the incredible prize donors you could win a critique from: https://lydialukidis.wordpress.com/fallwritingfrenzy-2026-donors/ Please do what you can to support these donors. Like Lydia and I they are volunteering their time to help wonderful writers like you. See the full rules here: https://lydialukidis.wordpress.com/fallwritingfrenzy-2026-rules/ Make sure to share with all your kidlit writing/querying friends. Lydia and I can’t wait to read your entries! Good luck! Sincerely, Kaitlyn Sanchez

posts.title: 2026 Kidlit Zombie Week Day 2: The Many Resyrrections of No Legs, No Limits by Kanya Sesser and Nisha Lamsam Ligon
posts.description: Hi, everyone! Kaitlyn Sanchez here! I’m so excited to share this awesome blog guest blog post by my wonderful clients Kanya Sesser and Nisha Lamsam Ligon . This is about the journey their book took to publication, and I hope it inspires you in your revisions. Without further ado, here are Kanya and Nisha! The Many Manuscript Resurrections of No Legs, No Limits by Kanya Sesser and Nisha Lamsam Ligon What’s purple and yellow, has no legs, and has gone through more resurrections than a zombie on the Walking Dead? Our picture book, NO LEGS, NO LIMITS ! We connected with each other in August 2022, bonded through our shared Thai heritage, and immediately decided to write a picture book together. It was a no-brainer: with Kanya’s amazing story (from being found on a roadside in Thailand to becoming a champion para-athlete, model and actor), plus Nisha’s experience writing for children (co-creator of multiple award-winning kids’ TV shows), we’d have a perfect picture book ready for publication
